subject: reasoning
question:
In the figure given below the circle represents dogs, the rectangle represents cats and the triangle represents cows. Number in each area represents the number of items in that area.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e6c976e056b2840f9b0f347c6474e1726a48822cae2649c3639d77e3080f1ae8.png] 

How many cows are neither dogs nor cats?
solution:
According to the given Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d575e2cb2e6a44e306e7097675446faaea8df95455aa5858fa6cd2205276ecc2.png] 

The shaded area show the total number of cows that are neither dogs nor cats.

So, total number of cows that are neither dogs nor cats = 10.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
